claims.statement: Vercel documents the prefix vcr_ for Vercel app refresh tokens.

sources.supports: As part of this change, we've also updated token and API key formats to make them visually identifiable. Each credential type now includes a prefix: vcr for Vercel app refresh tokens

claims.statement: No Vercel page read on 2026-10-06 states a length for the vcr_ token. Pinned scanner rules by different maintainers (Kingfisher (MongoDB) and Betterleaks) all fix 56 characters after the prefix (Kingfisher as a 50-character body plus a 6-character checksum), and the one provider example carries a 56-character body: vcr_ example in the Sign in with Vercel tokens page response. This is consistency of the artifacts with 56, not a Vercel rule; the Kingfisher and Betterleaks examples reproduce the same documented example value, so their agreement on the example is not independent evidence of the length.

sources.supports: vcr_(?P<body>[A-Za-z0-9_-]{50})(?P<checksum>[A-Za-z0-9]{6}): a 50-character body and a 6-character checksum after the prefix
vcr_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{56}: 56 characters after the prefix
vcr_ example in the Sign in with Vercel tokens page response

claims.statement: The alphabet of the body is not settled. The pinned rules disagree: Kingfisher admits _ and - in the first 50 characters and only [A-Za-z0-9] in the last 6; Betterleaks admits _ and - throughout. Vercel's own Azure DevOps extension masks vcr_ followed by [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ with no length. Every Vercel example read is alphanumeric. No Vercel page states an alphabet.

sources.supports: redactSecrets masks vcp_ and vca_ values with [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ (no vcr_ rule)

claims.statement: Pinned scanner rules are consistent with the contract grammar (2 artifacts: betterleaks; kingfisher).

sources.supports: betterleaks: vc[pikar]_ + 56 [A-Za-z0-9_-] (derived from kingfisher)
kingfisher: vc[pikar]_ + 50 [A-Za-z0-9_-] + 6 [A-Za-z0-9] (Base62 CRC-32 tail); its vca_/vcr_ examples copy the Vercel docs value

claims.statement: checksum: the last 6 characters may be base62 (0-9A-Za-z) of the CRC-32 of the 50 before them (Not enforced and never a twin: positives carry a matching and a mismatching tail.)

openQuestions.question: Does Vercel state the length of a vcr_ token anywhere (an API reference, a changelog entry, a support article)? Until it does, 56 characters after the prefix rests on scanner rules and one example.
May the body contain _ or -? The scanner rules and Vercel's own masker admit them; the examples do not use them. A Vercel statement of the alphabet would settle it.
